rows.criterion: A valid public answer was saved
rows.reason: A transport result, empty answer or error string does not count as advice.

rows.criterion: The test persona has an unchanged original hash
rows.reason: This checks the saved lock receipt, not representativeness or citizenship.

rows.criterion: The public opening actually states the selected situation
rows.reason: Generated UserSim wording may vary; omitted constraints do not count as a successful Saturday/S$50 demonstration.

rows.criterion: Recommendation links and IDs belong to the frozen catalogue
rows.reason: An exact catalogue URL identifies a listing; internal course IDs are optional. Other factual sentences still need review.

rows.criterion: Explicit venue planning-area claims match the cited facts
rows.reason: Checks explicit planning-area attribution phrases: ['toa payoh']; cited source areas: ['toa payoh']. This does not establish proximity or cover every geographic expression.

rows.criterion: Explicit fee fields match published catalogue amounts
rows.reason: Checks labelled fee amounts [10.0] against published amounts [10.0]; does not infer an all-in total.

rows.criterion: Recommended listings respect the publicly stated budget and day
rows.reason: Constraints are extracted only from the saved public learner turn, never the private persona.

rows.criterion: No unsupported fee or funding assurance pattern
rows.reason: A narrow phrase check; a pass does not certify every financial statement.

rows.criterion: Native tool evidence includes a completed catalogue request
rows.reason: Native Relay evidence is required; an application log saying “searched” is insufficient.

coverage: Exact course URLs/IDs, explicit planning-area and fee phrases, source lock, stated constraints, selected assurance patterns and native tool evidence. Other factual phrasing, proximity, seats and personal eligibility require review.
